# Design System Master File

> **LOGIC:** When building a specific page, first check `design-system/odoo-backup-panel/pages/[page-name].md`.
> If that file exists, its rules **override** this Master file.
> If not, strictly follow the rules below.

---

**Project:** Odoo Backup Panel ("Backup Console")
**Source:** generated by ui-ux-pro-max on 2026-10-28 (`--design-system --density 8`), then redesigned on
2026-10-29 from the owner's mockups (kept outside the repo because they carry real names) per
`docs/decisions.md` D10. Tokens live in `backup_panel/panel/static/panel/app.css` (`:root`); components
use tokens only. Contrast is checked with `scripts/check_contrast.py`.
**Category:** internal operations / developer tool dashboard
**Design Dials:** Density 8/10 (Dense / Dashboard)

---

## Global Rules

### Color Palette

Light is the default; dark follows `prefers-color-scheme: dark`, and `data-theme="light|dark"` on `<html>`
forces either (no toggle in the UI). Components use tokens only, never raw hex.

| Token | Light | Dark | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bg` | `#F7F7F5` | `#0B0D10` | page background, inputs, log |
| `panel` | `#FFFFFF` | `#12151A` | panels, tables, topbar sticky areas |
| `panel-2` | `#F2F2EF` | `#171B22` | table headers, row hover, switch box |
| `line` | `#E2E2DC` | `#242A35` | hairlines |
| `line-strong` | `#7C8594` | `#5F6B7A` | borders of buttons and inputs (3:1) |
| `text` | `#15171A` | `#E9EDF3` | primary text |
| `muted` | `#5B6472` | `#9AA5B4` | secondary text |
| `faint` | `#656D7A` | `#7D8998` | hints, sub-lines, placeholders (still 4.5:1) |
| `accent` | `#0F6B5F` | `#2DD4BF` | actions, links, focus, active nav, running |
| `on-accent` / `accent-soft` | `#FFFFFF` / `#E2F0ED` | `#06201C` / `#0F2A26` | text on accent / tinted background |
| `good` / `good-soft` | `#147A39` / `#E8F5EC` | `#3DDC97` / `#10241B` | Fresh, done, success |
| `warn` / `warn-soft` | `#92600A` / `#FDF1E3` | `#F5A524` / `#2A2113` | Stale, No backups yet, warnings **only** |
| `bad` / `bad-soft` | `#C2410C` / `#FDECEC` | `#FF6B6B` / `#2A1517` | failed, stopped, errors, danger button |

Teal means "do something / it is happening"; amber means "look at this"; they are never swapped.

### Typography

- **UI:** IBM Plex Sans 400–600. **Mono:** JetBrains Mono 400–500 for file names, database and container
  names, cron, logs. Both SIL OFL 1.1, self-hosted as variable woff2 (latin), `font-display: swap`.
- Scale: 12 / 13 / 14 (body) / 16 / 20 (page title) / 28 (detail title). Inputs 16px on ≤720px.
  Numbers in tables and facts use tabular figures.

### Spacing, shape

4/8 rhythm (`--s1`…`--s8` = 4…64px). Flat: 1px lines, no shadows. Radius 10px panels, 6px controls.
Content width 72rem, gutters `clamp(16px, 4vw, 40px)`.

---

## Component Specs

Reference implementation: `app.css`.

- **Buttons** (`.btn`, 36px, 44px on coarse pointers): `--primary` (one per view), `--ghost`, `--danger`
  (restore only), `--sm` (32px). Disabled = `disabled` + opacity .45 + the reason beside it.
- **Panel** (`.panel` + `__head/__body/__foot`): not clickable. Tables inside scroll horizontally
  (`.tablewrap`), never the page.
- **Status** (`.status--good|warn|bad|idle|run`): **always icon + text**, never colour alone; a second line
  (`.reason`) says why (Stale, stopped, unreadable).
- **Alerts** (`.alert--bad|good|warn|info`): icon, heading, text; `role="status"`/`alert` where live.
- **Job panel** (`.job`): head (title + status), progress bar (`role="progressbar"`), steps (`.runsteps`
  `data-s=todo|active|done|failed`, each with a visible state word), log (`pre.log`, focusable), foot with
  elapsed time and "Tutup".
- **Wizard** (`.wizard`, `.stepper`, `.step`): works as one long form without script; with script it shows
  one step at a time (`data-js`), numbered stepper with `aria-current="step"`, "Lanjut" in step 2 stays
  disabled until every check passes, type-to-confirm in step 3.
- **Inputs** (`.input`): 42px, visible label, hint, error below with `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`.
- **Loading**: `.skel` skeleton rows and panels (shimmer off under reduced motion), spinner only for work.
- **Toast**: bottom right, 5 seconds, `role="status"` (download started).
- **Icons**: Lucide SVG (`aria-hidden`), 16px.

---

## Page Pattern

**App shell** (no landing page, D3): sticky topbar (brand, nav Instance | Aktivitas with `aria-current`,
user, Keluar) → crumbs → head → content. Pages: login, instances (a panel per server, one table, rows load
lazily), instance detail (two columns: job panel + backups; aside with status facts, last job, restore note),
restore wizard, job page, Aktivitas. Details: `docs/ui.md`.

---

## Anti-Patterns (Do NOT Use)

- Emojis as icons; status by colour only; hover lift or pointer cursor on non-clickable panels.
- Raw hex in templates — use tokens. Amber for anything that is not a warning.
- Truncated file or database names — wrap instead.
- CDN scripts, fonts, or `@latest` — everything is vendored.
- More than one primary button per view. Invisible focus or removed outlines.
- Django-admin wording ("Select X to change") in the UI.

---

## Pre-Delivery Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_contrast.py` passes (all pairs, light and dark)
- [ ] No emojis; all icons Lucide; one primary action per view
- [ ] Visible focus ring; skip link to `#main`; tab order follows the visual order
- [ ] Every field has a visible label; errors next to the field with `aria-describedby`
- [ ] Status and job state readable without colour (icon + word)
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` stops spinner, shimmer and transitions
- [ ] Inputs 16px on ≤720px; targets ≥44px on coarse pointers
- [ ] Long names wrap; no horizontal page scroll at 375px
- [ ] Checked at 375 / 768 / 1024 / 1440px, in light and dark (by eye, in a browser)
